meta.collision_recovery_definition: first two consecutive grounded, collision-free frames above 50% pre-impact ground speed with yaw-rate error <= max(0.05, 25% expected)
meta.wall_stick_definition: consecutive direct wall-contact frames with ground speed below 10% of asphalt BASE_TOP_SPEED; independent of new collision impulses
meta.kart_kart_collision_coverage: available: kart_kart_collision events include both participants and impulses
meta.landing_angle_definition: angle between pre-landing ground velocity and downward vertical; >=45° smooth, <45° steep
meta.landing_speed_retention_definition: post/pre ground speed, capped at 1 to exclude same-tick drive acceleration from landing impact loss
meta.surface_definition: R13 uses two short angular sectors inside the existing annular lane; surface probes report raw target frames and a settled asphalt reference sweep
